name: unbound
title: Unbound
description: Unbound is a validating, recursive DNS resolver: it asks the root servers itself instead of forwarding to Google or Cloudflare, with DNSSEC. Made to sit behind AdGuard Home or Pi-hole — set their upstream DNS to <this host's IP>:5335.

variables.name: PORT_UNBOUND
variables.label: DNS port
variables.description: TCP and UDP; AdGuard/Pi-hole use it as upstream
